# Support

- Questions and ideas: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Aurtechmx/openlidarviewer/discussions).
- Bugs: open an issue with the bug report form.
- Security issues: report privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- Documentation: [openlidarviewer.org](https://openlidarviewer.org/).

What to include when you ask is described in [docs/project/SUPPORT.md](../docs/project/SUPPORT.md).
